images.title: Fractions in three pictures
images.purpose: Sum up the chapter in three panels: a whole cut into equal parts, the same amount in a new unit, and adding once the units are the same.
images.composition: Three equal panels side by side with wide gaps, each holding one simple object with its heading above and one line below.
images.exact_structure: Panel 1: one flat round roti cut by 2 straight lines through the centre into exactly 4 equal parts; 1 part filled teal #0072B2. Panel 2: two strips of exactly the same length, one above the other, left edges lined up; the top strip in 2 equal parts with 1 filled teal, the bottom strip in 4 equal parts with 2 filled amber #E69F00; the filled lengths match. Panel 3: one strip of the same length in 4 equal parts; 1 part teal, the next 2 parts amber, the last plain. Exactly 3 panels.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
strips of different lengths, or roti parts that are not equal
images.takeaway: Equal parts, same unit, then add or take away.
images.description: Three panels: a roti in 4 equal parts with 1/4 teal; two equal strips showing 1/2 = 2/4; and a strip in fourths showing 1/4 + 2/4 = 3/4.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to walk through the panels from left to right and say the one idea each panel shows.

image_decisions.why: A tidy three-panel picture gathers the chapter's main ideas into one view for the recap.
